name: Primary production food safety and export controls
what: Meet primary production standards for meat, dairy, seafood and eggs under state agencies, and Commonwealth export controls and registration to export food and agricultural products.

layers.who: State primary production food safety agency
State primary production food safety agency

basis.source: Agriculture, forestry and fishing industry (industry information)
basis.quote: The Biosecurity Act 2015 may apply if your business grows, moves, imports or exports plants, animals or related products.

issues.what: Meat processors meet different state standards and international requirements, so certification costs far more than for competitors overseas.

evidence.quote: Inconsistency with international standards and across states and territories is imposing compliance costs for Australian red meat processing facilities that are far higher than those faced by global competitors.
